about: Which workflow puts each tracked file where (restructure J5.3). Every file in the repo matches exactly one entry (the longest path that starts it); a folder is deployed by at most one workflow. tools/workflows_test.mjs checks both, and that each workflow uploads only the folders given to it here. 'workflow': null means the file is never uploaded as it is (it may still be read by a tool or built into something). Part of the Handbook (docs/handbook/data-map.md says how the stores behave).
